text:
Nora B: Hey team, first-week question  I tried opening Console (staging) to follow the FF playbook but got a 403. My manager Sam asked me to test a rollout on a dedicated pool later. Who do I ask for staging admin vs dedicated environment access?
Sam K: @Nora B welcome! Staging-only admin is a lighter process. Dedicated capacity access (reserved GPUs) requires an infra/finance approval because it's billed differently. Start with a single ticket and list both entitlements you need.
DevEx Bot: Heads up  entitlements: console-admin:staging, ff-operator, and for dedicated-related console panels there's dedicated-monitor and dedicated-deploy. Include purpose + duration in the ticket.
Nora B: Filing REQ-8122 now (okta: nora.b@redwood.dev). Planning a 2-day staging test, then a demo on dedicated read-only later in week.
Onboard Bot: Tip: attach manager approval screenshot and include the exact flag key(s) you want to touch. Suggested flag naming for demo: demo/onboard/nora-1.
Infra Team: We can do staging-only in ~30m. Dedicated console roles need billing team OK and an SRE review. If it's read-only on dedicated we can sometimes do a short-lived view role without full commit. Nora, please confirm exact dedicated panel you need: view-only metrics or deploy controls?
Nora B: For the dedicated demo I just need view-only metrics and a runbook check (no deploys). So dedicated-monitor view-only should suffice.
SRE Team: For any dedicated access we need a short justification because it touches capacity pools. Please paste the test plan in the ticket and we'll triage. Also after grant, run this smoke to verify API reachability: 
```bash
export REDWOOD_TOKEN=...
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://api.staging.redwood/health | jq .status
```
Expect: "ok".
Ella M: Granting console-admin:staging and ff-operator to nora.b@redwood.dev for 3 business days now. We'll wait on the dedicated-monitor request until the ticket has billing ack.
Nora B: I can access Admin -> Feature Flags and toggled demo/onboard/nora-1. Health returned "ok". Thanks Ella! :tada:
Sam K: Great. I'll add a short note to REQ-8122 for billing to review dedicated-monitor view-only. If billing approves, Infra can attach the dedicated role for a 24-hour demo window.
Infra Team: Sounds good. One security reminder: do not toggle prod flags and do not reuse temporary tokens in shared scripts. Use the service token store or your personal token via the console 'API Keys' page.
Nora B: Noted. I'll close REQ-8122 after the dedicated demo and upload the test log. Appreciate the quick help everyone.
DevEx Bot: For a guided FF walkthrough or demo in dedicated view, book a 20-min slot with #devex and we'll join. Docs: https://go/redwood-devex/ff-playbook
